baseline_models.focus_anchor: The named subject Allah, the relational phrase min wara'ihim, and the active participle muhit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The far side supplied by wara' and the physical enclosure supplied by muhit combine into a closed topology: the side assumed to be behind or outside the group is already occupied by the encompassing subject.

activation_trace.role: The fixed divine name supplies the explicit encompassing subject rather than an impersonal boundary.
The far side as behind, ahead, or beyond supplies the apparently open side that the mechanism closes.
Physical surrounding and enclosure turn relative position into a perimeter with no exterior route.

changed_reading.before: Allah is located behind them while also surrounding them.
changed_reading.after: Their presumed rear or beyond is not an escape side at all; it is already one face of a total enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wara'ihim can mark what is put beyond appearance, while muhit can denote complete grasp in knowledge or possession.
baseline_models.mechanism: A concealment layer and an exhaustive grasp are superimposed. What the group places out of sight or behind its presented surface remains fully known and held.

activation_trace.role: The fixed name identifies whose grasp crosses the visible and concealed layers.
Covering something and placing it out of sight supplies the hidden layer behind their outward presentation.
Complete grasp in knowledge or possession makes concealment ineffective rather than merely spatially surrounded.

changed_reading.before: Behind them names a location and encompassing names spatial reach.
changed_reading.after: Behind them also names their hidden side, and encompassing means that this concealed interior is completely known and held.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unspecified plural object permits care as well as threat, while wara' supplies a rearward relation and ihatah includes protective tending.
baseline_models.mechanism: Position at the rear can function as support, and surrounding can function as guarding. Before context identifies the plural, the clause can therefore carry a rear-guard reading alongside capture.

activation_trace.role: The named divine subject makes the possible rear support an intentional relation.
The branch's aid and defense idiom supplies a tentative rear-support function to the wara' relation.
Guarding, preservation, and attentive care allow encompassing to shelter rather than only confine.

changed_reading.before: Encompassing from behind is necessarily hostile containment.
changed_reading.after: With the plural still unidentified, the same geometry can provisionally describe a guarding presence at the rear.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The far-side relation is paired with an active participle whose inventory includes circling, maneuver, overpowering, and ruin.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maneuver around a target turns a static ring into an active outflanking process. The group is not merely inside a known boundary; its attempts to reposition are continually overtaken until inability results.

activation_trace.role: Behind, ahead, and beyond supply multiple sides across which an outflanking movement can operate.
Going around and maneuvering makes the encompassing relation active and adaptive.
Overwhelming encirclement ending in ruin supplies the terminal state of the maneuver.

changed_reading.before: Allah statically surrounds a stationary group.
changed_reading.after: Allah continually outflanks the group across every attempted change of position, making eventual inability part of muhit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening overhead sky and its fortified or celestial towers scale the focus enclosure beyond a local pursuit. The created upper boundary becomes an immense architectural perimeter within which the group remains enclosed.

activation_trace.role: The other side or beyond supplies the apparent outside of the cosmic structure.
Physical enclosure turns the sky-and-towers scale into a containing perimeter.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the enclosure's upper span.
Fortified towers give the overhead span an architectural and resistant boundary function.

structural_cues: The surah opens with an overhead expanse bearing towers and later places Allah min wara'ihim, so vertical scale precedes rearward enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an overshadowing sky and fortified towers; I infer upper span plus resistant boundary -> cosmic enclosure. A live alternative is that the oath imagery contributes scale without defining the mechanism of 85:20.

changed_reading.before: The group is enclosed in an unspecified local space.
changed_reading.after: The group is enclosed inside a cosmic-scale fortress whose apparent beyond remains within divine reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed promised time, followed by beginning and return, converts spatial beyond into temporal beyond. Encompassing reaches the group's before, duration, appointed horizon, and return rather than only its present location.

activation_trace.role: Wara' as ahead, after, or beyond opens a temporal as well as spatial far side.
Complete grasp supplies continuity across the whole temporal course.
A bounded duration supplies a temporal interval that can itself be encompassed.
An appointment fixed to time or place gives the beyond a determinate horizon rather than indefinite futurity.
Beginning paired with repetition supplies one endpoint and the transition toward return.
Return after departure closes the temporal circuit around the group's course.

structural_cues: The promised day appears near the opening, and the paired verbs 'begins and returns' later make sequence itself explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed day and a beginning-return pair; I infer temporal endpoints -> an encompassing timeline. The alternative is that these clauses establish power over resurrection without altering the spatial force of wara'ihim.

changed_reading.before: Allah blocks the group's route behind or around them now.
changed_reading.after: Allah also occupies what is after them: their appointed future and return are already inside the encompassing relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated exchange of witness and witnessed turns the group's hidden rear into an impossible blind side. Their own watching of violence is nested inside a presence and knowledge that sees the watchers and can make what is seen declaratively evident.

activation_trace.role: Putting something beyond appearance supplies the blind side the group might presume to control.
Complete knowledge from all sides removes the epistemic exterior.
Presence with direct seeing supplies the reciprocal witness-and-witnessed field.
The perpetrators' presence while watching their own acts makes them watchers who are also available to be watched.
Testimony or disclosure grounded in knowledge converts comprehensive seeing into evidentiary accountability.

structural_cues: Witness and witnessed open the account; the perpetrators are then witnesses of their acts; Allah is finally witness over every thing before 85:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested acts of witnessing and comprehensive divine testimony; I infer watcher reversal -> no unseen rear. The alternative is that witness language establishes evidence independently of the spatial image in 85:20.

changed_reading.before: Encompassing means that the group cannot move outside divine reach.
changed_reading.after: Encompassing also means that the self-watching perpetrators cannot produce a blind side outside divine presence, knowledge, or testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The persecutors construct a deep linear enclosure, feed its fire, and sit in surveillance around it. The focus clause reverses scale and agency: those who made a lethal inside for others are themselves inside a larger enclosure approached from the side they did not watch.

activation_trace.role: The far or other side supplies the unguarded exterior of the persecutors' own arrangement.
Physical surrounding nests their trench perimeter inside a larger counter-perimeter.
Overwhelming encirclement ending in inability reverses the lethal force of the trench onto its makers.
The deep longitudinal cleft supplies the persecutors' engineered inside.
Blazing fire supplies the trench's active lethal boundary.
Fuel material makes the local enclosure deliberately sustained rather than accidental.
Sitting in ambush or watch supplies the perpetrators' confident control of the visible perimeter.

structural_cues: The perpetrators sit over the trench and watch what they do, while 85:20 later places Allah specifically beyond or behind them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trench, sustained fire, and perimeter-watching; I infer local enclosure nested inside larger enclosure -> reversal of captor and captive. The alternative is a direct threat with no intentional mirroring of the trench geometry.

changed_reading.after: Their own trench becomes a miniature and inverted anticipation of the enclosure that already surrounds its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The form-distant hidden-fire branch under wara' is ignited by the context's repeated fire, fuel, and burning. It produces a reversal in which the visible fire they kindle carries an unseen consequence already kindled beyond their field of view and capable of closing around them.

activation_trace.role: Hidden fire emerging from a fire-stick supplies the latent ignition concealed within the focus word's root inventory.
Overwhelming enclosure gives the hidden ignition a rebound destination in the persecutors' ruin.
The explicitly blazing fire activates the focus root's otherwise remote latent-fire image.
Kindling and ignition supply the causal transition from dormant fire to active consequence.
Flame recurring as punishment supplies the contextual rebound from their fire to a fire directed at them.

structural_cues: Fire with fuel appears in 85:5 and returns as the punishment of burning in 85:10 before the focus statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal kindling, fuel, and a later punitive flame; I infer contextual ignition -> activation of the hidden-fire branch in wara'. The live alternative is that this is sound/root resonance only and should not affect the ordinary relational meaning of wara'ihim.

changed_reading.before: Behind them marks an unseen spatial side.
changed_reading.after: The unseen side also flickers as a latent counter-fire: what they kindle visibly has an already kindled consequence beyond their sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context identifies the conflict as punishment for trusting and worshipping Allah. The focus subject is therefore also the contested object of allegiance, while the plural object becomes the persecuting party: those who tried to surround worshippers are surrounded by the One worshipped.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped one make the focus subject the very allegiance disputed in the persecution.
Physical surrounding supplies the reversal of who ultimately contains whom.
Heart-settling trust supplies the believers' allegiance that provokes the attack.
Disapproval and fault-finding supply the persecutors' hostile response to that allegiance.
The worshipped one explicitly identifies the object of the believers' trust and the social conflict.

structural_cues: The exclusive construction in 85:8 gives belief in Allah as the sole grievance, and 85:19 immediately supplies the disbelieving plural resumed by 85:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sole grievance, its object, and the adjacent disbelieving plural; I infer persecuted allegiance -> reversal of the persecutors' enclosing power. The alternative is that Allah in 85:20 functions only as judge, without the social-role reversal.

changed_reading.before: An unidentified group stands inside divine enclosure.
changed_reading.after: The enclosing group that attacked people for allegiance to Allah is itself enclosed by the very One whose worship it tried to suppress.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dominion, totality, and knowledgeable testimony turn muhit from geometry into sovereign custody. The group is not only surrounded but fully within a domain whose owner knows and can establish every relevant thing.

activation_trace.role: Complete grasp in knowledge or possession supplies the bridge from enclosure to custody.
Ownership with power of disposal makes the encompassing domain one of effective possession.
Kingship and sovereignty scale custody across the heavens and earth named in the same clause.
Wholeness as enclosure and completion supplies the clause's exhaustive scope.
Knowledgeable declaration gives sovereign grasp an evidentiary rather than merely territorial function.

structural_cues: In one sentence, 85:9 coordinates Allah's dominion of heavens and earth with His witness over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, sovereignty, totality, and testimony; I infer domain plus knowledge -> juridical custody. The alternative is that these are independent divine attributes and muhit remains purely spatial or punitive.

changed_reading.after: The group is already in the owner's comprehensive custody, with every act available as known evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punishment clause is conditioned by failure to repent, while forgiveness and love remain live divine predicates. Enclosure therefore does not have to mean that every path is closed: it can close escape from truth while still containing a path of return before punitive closure.

activation_trace.role: Overwhelming enclosure and ruin supply the punitive edge that the context condition qualifies.
Protective tending preserves a live non-punitive value within the same encompassing root.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer from the effect supplies a possible release from ruin without escape from divine reach.
Love and affection prevent the encompassing relation from collapsing into hostility alone.

structural_cues: 85:10 assigns punishment after 'then they did not repent', and 85:14 names Allah forgiving and loving before the focus threat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed-repentance condition plus forgiveness and love; I infer a moral opening inside inescapable reach -> return rather than evasion. The alternative is that mercy concerns other recipients and does not qualify the focus enclosure of deniers.

changed_reading.before: Being encompassed means that the deniers have no path at all.
changed_reading.after: They have no path outside Allah's reach, but the context leaves a path of repentant return within that reach before ruin closes over them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context removes the direct protective reading for the focus pronoun by identifying it with deniers, yet it does not erase protective ihatah. Instead, protective force is reoriented: enclosing the aggressors limits their reach and functions as a shield for the faithful whom they attacked.

activation_trace.role: Aid and defense retain the rear-guard possibility but redirect its beneficiary away from the deniers.
Guarding and protective care make restraint of the attackers simultaneously protective for others.
Security and settled trust identify the community toward whom the protective orientation can turn.
A protective shield supplies the contextual counterpart to enclosing the aggressors.
Continuous provision gives the protected side a sustained positive outcome rather than bare survival.

structural_cues: The faithful receive gardens and flowing provision in 85:11, while the adjacent 85:19 identifies the focus pronoun's antecedent as the deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protected believers and an adjacent denier antecedent; I infer enclosing aggressor -> shielding victim. The alternative is that protective hiyatah is inactive here and the focus clause concerns only capture of its grammatical object.

changed_reading.before: Allah may be a rear guard protecting the unidentified 'them'.
changed_reading.after: Context makes 'them' the aggressors, so the viable protection reading becomes relational: surrounding them protects those beyond their reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Severe seizure, unconstrained doing, will, and mutually supporting troops turn dynamic outflanking into a deliberate counter-siege. Organized collective force does not oppose an inert perimeter; it is maneuvered around and taken by a stronger intentional agency.

activation_trace.role: Behind, ahead, and beyond provide the several fronts across which the counter-siege outflanks.
Circling and maneuvering supply the operation rather than a static condition.
Overwhelming encirclement supplies the operation's result in inability or ruin.
Taking with force supplies the decisive seizure inside the encirclement.
Strength and solidity remove the possibility that the encompassing operation is fragile.
Bringing an act into occurrence supplies effective agency rather than latent capacity.
Will and intention give the maneuver a chosen direction.
A mutually supporting troop supplies the organized collective that is nevertheless outflanked.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from severe divine seizure, through doing whatever is willed, to the report of troops before naming the deniers and divine enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forceful seizure, effective willing, and organized troops; I infer intentional superior maneuver -> counter-siege. The alternative is that each cue separately asserts power and historical warning without specifying military geometry in 85:20.

changed_reading.before: The group happens to be surrounded by superior reach.
changed_reading.after: Even as a mutually supporting force, the group is deliberately outmaneuvered and seized across every front by effective divine will.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering truth and imposing a false account form the deniers' attempted screen. Because Allah is beyond that screen and completely grasps it, denial neither hides the act nor creates an alternative reality outside the encompassing field.

activation_trace.role: Concealment behind a displayed surface supplies the representational screen made by denial.
Complete grasp in knowledge or possession penetrates and contains the screen.
Covering supplies denial's basic operation of putting truth out of view.
Veiling truth specifies what the covering attempts to exclude from recognition.
Assigning falsehood to a thing or speaker supplies the active false frame laid over the covered truth.

structural_cues: 85:19 places the deniers 'in denial' immediately before the contrastive focus clause naming Allah beyond them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth-covering and attribution of falsehood; I infer screen-making -> failed epistemic refuge under complete grasp. The alternative is that kufr and takdhib identify culpability only and do not spatialize denial as a screen.

changed_reading.before: Allah is behind the deniers as a pursuing power.
changed_reading.after: Allah is also behind the cover-story they inhabit; their denial is a screen contained within, not outside, divine knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The move from denial to gathered recitation on a guarded writing surface gives the focus enclosure a textual consequence. The deniers are surrounded not only as bodies and knowers but by a counter-record whose transmission and substrate lie beyond their attempt to suppress it.

activation_trace.role: Beyond or after supplies the side on which the message persists past the deniers' immediate frame.
Guarding and preservation let encompassing carry a custodial register alongside capture.
Gathering and collection supply the message as a coherent counter-record rather than scattered speech.
Reading and recitation supply the record's repeatable transmission beyond the immediate confrontation.
A broad surface for writing supplies the durable substrate of the counter-record.
Guarding and watchful preservation prevent the deniers from controlling the record's survival.

structural_cues: Immediately after Allah encompasses the deniers, 85:21-22 contrast their denial with a glorious recitation in a preserved tablet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial followed by collected recitation, writing surface, and guarding; I infer preserved counter-record -> a textual dimension of being encompassed. The alternative is that preservation describes the Quran alone and does not feed back into muhit.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are enclosed in space and knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is also enclosed by a preserved counter-record that remains gathered, recitable, and guarded beyond their control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the round-ornament branch is object-specific and the focus names no ornament. It remains anchored in muhit and is activated by the opening sky and celestial towers; downstream prose should present it only as a visual analogy for cosmic enclosure, never as the lexical gloss of muhit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The active participle muhit supplies circular enclosure, while its branch inventory includes a round ornament.

activation_trace.role: The round ornament supplies a compact circlet image for the encompassing form.
The overshadowing sky enlarges the circlet from a bodily ornament to a cosmic visual field.
Celestial towers supply visible stations around the imagined cosmic ring.

changed_reading.before: Encompassing is an abstract all-around relation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the constellated sky makes the enclosure visible as a vast circlet whose stations surround the deniers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins an accounting-specific hwt branch to a non-dominant mapped branch under the promised event. It remains packet-resolvable and anchored in muhit's completion image, reinforced by contextual totality; downstream prose should qualify it as an accounting analogy for exhaustiveness, not derive a primary meaning of 85:20 from the split mapping.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The muhit root inventory includes the amount that completes deficient dirhams, allowing enclosure to be tested as exhaustive completion.

activation_trace.role: The amount completing a monetary shortfall supplies an exact no-deficit model of encompassing.
The non-dominant mapped image of enumerating what is counted activates an accounting register around the promised horizon.
Wholeness as enclosure and completion generalizes the accounting image into exhaustive scope.

changed_reading.before: Allah surrounds the group without any explicit metric.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, muhit says the final account has no shortfall: every omitted remainder is supplied and every item falls within the total.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grandchild branch is form-distant and the focus pronoun most naturally resumes present deniers, not descendants. It remains anchored in wara' as what comes after and is activated by recitation plus preservation; downstream prose should carry it only as a temporal echo that their power is outlasted, not as a claim that wara'ihim directly denotes their offspring.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wara'ihim supplies what comes after them, and the same root inventory includes a descendant arriving after the child.

activation_trace.role: A grandchild coming after a child supplies generational succession as a remote image of what lies behind or after them.
Preservative care supplies continuity across the generations evoked by the after-image.
Repeatable recitation supplies transmission after the deniers' own moment has passed.
Persistent observance and maintenance supply durability across successive times.

changed_reading.before: Allah is behind the deniers within their present confrontation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, what comes after their generation is also encompassed: preserved recitation outlasts the horizon of their denial.

strongest_changes: The trench-makers' local enclosure is inverted inside a larger divine counter-enclosure.
Repeated witness language changes spatial surrounding into a field with no epistemic blind side.
Dominion, totality, and testimony change muhit into sovereign custody rather than geometry alone.
Kufr and takdhib turn denial into a failed screen already contained by complete knowledge.
The following preserved recitation gives encompassing a coexisting custodial and textual consequence.
The context reorients protective ihatah away from protecting the deniers and toward restraining them for the sake of those they attacked.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause behaves as a reversal engine. The persecutors watch, enclose, burn, organize, and cover; context makes each operation recur at a larger scale as divine witness, counter-enclosure, latent rebound, superior maneuver, or penetration of concealment. At the same time, care, repentance, and preservation keep punitive capture from exhausting the root's live possibilities.
remaining_uncertainties: The direct antecedent of -him strongly favors the deniers in 85:19, so protective readings work best as protection against them rather than care for them.
The hidden-fire activation is visibly prompted by the fire sequence but remains form-distant from ordinary wara' and should stay exploratory.
Spatial, epistemic, temporal, sovereign, and textual enclosure can coexist, but the packet does not force one ordering among them.
The mercy-gate reading depends on carrying the repentance condition and forgiving-love predicates into muhit rather than treating them as separate assertions.
The accounting and posterity outliers depend on remote or split-mapping branches and should not be promoted into unqualified lexical claims.
